name: OCBC Frank Card

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income:
•At least S$30,000 for Singaporeans and Singapore PRs aged between 21 and 54
•At least S$15,000 for Singaporeans and Singapore PRs aged 55 and above

our_takes.our-take: The OCBC Frank Card’s 8% cashback on online/mobile contactless and foreign currency transactions is attractive, but requires a steep S$800 minimum monthly spend. This makes it ideal for those with consistent, significant spending in these categories. Miss the threshold, and you only get 0.3% cashback. The S$25 cap per category limits maximum rewards(S$100). Consider if your spending habits align with these categories and the high minimum to maximize its value; otherwise, a card with lower spending requirements might be more suitable.
our_takes.good-for:
Young adults who frequently shop online or via mobile, seeking cashback on everyday digital transactions.
Individuals who make frequent foreign currency transactions and want to maximize cashback on those international purchases.
Environmentally conscious consumers looking for cashback rewards when spending at selected eco-friendly merchants and sustainable transport options.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Spending less than S$800 monthly means only 0.3% cashback, greatly reducing your rewards potential.
Missing the minimum monthly repayment means incurring a hefty S$100 late payment fee.
Exceeding the S$100 monthly cashback cap means you won't earn rewards on extra spending.
